test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Marks of five girls Mansi, Kajal, Reetu, Tina and Riya are compared Marks of Riya are less than Mansi but more than Tina. Marks of Reetu are less than Tina, Riya and Mansi. Marks of Kajal are less than Reetu. Marks of how many girls are less than the marks of Riya?
solution:
Marks of five girls Mansi, Kajal, Reetu, Tina and Riya are compared

1) Marks of Riya are less than Mansi but more than Tina.

Mansi > Riya > Tina

2) Marks of Reetu are less than Tina, Riya and Mansi.

Mansi > Riya > Tina > Reetu

3) Marks of Kajal are less than Reetu.

Mansi > Riya > Tina > Reetu > Kajal

∴ Here, marks of 3 girls are less than the marks of Riya

Hence, the correct answer is** "3".**
